post.caption:
Cryptochrome proteins in a bird's retina appear to react to magnetic fields via electron spin, which would overlay direction onto vision. Sea turtles and salmon use magnetic maps too. The same field that shields the planet from the solar wind is also a global navigation system that life learned to read.
